_comment: The lifecycle phases (plan -> build -> review -> deploy): what work each phase allows, and
the check that must pass to leave it. ONE text, read by the SessionStart hook, the console
badge and the docs through _lib.phase_contract(), so the three can never disagree.
contract: at most five short lines, printed at session start in the guided-solo and
fableous-orchestrated modes (freestyle prints only the mode line). exit: the NAME of the
exit check, bound to code in checkctl.PHASE_EXITS; `checkctl phase-exit --from <phase>`
runs it, and `statectl phase <next>` runs it first in the organised modes, refusing on
build_test_timeout: seconds each task's Test command may run in the build exit check.
drift_ignore: paths the ritual's deploy_drift check does not list as new work during
deploy ('dir/' matches that directory anywhere in a path, other entries are file globs).

plan.label: Plan
contract: Lay out the options and research them; record each choice with statectl decision.
Write the work as task files (/plan-task): a Definition of done and one Test command each.
Group the tasks under one milestone: statectl task <id> --milestone <mid>.
No product code yet: decide first, build next.
Exit check: every open task file is complete and registered under the milestone.

build.label: Build
contract: Implement the milestone's tasks, one task file at a time.
Keep each task's Test green; mark a task done only when its Test passes.
No scope growth: a new idea goes to statectl proposal add, not into this milestone.
Exit check: every task of the milestone is done and its Test exits 0 when rerun.

review.label: Review
contract: The human tests what was built and reports what they find.
Each finding becomes a fix task (back to build) or a proposal (statectl proposal add).
No new work in review: findings are recorded and routed, not fixed in passing.
Exit check: the human's sign-off, statectl phase <next> --signoff "<what was tested>".

deploy.label: Deploy
contract: Set up and verify the target: checkctl doctor.
New ideas go to statectl proposal add, never into code (the ritual lists new files).
Exit check: checkctl doctor has no FAIL.
